data.body: S7 change 1958 MERGED (8th change). Its CLOSE then FAILED completion verification - correctly. Two of S7's own ACs named tests/unit/test_audit_completion_v2.py and test_audit_ticket_page_heldout.py SPECIFICALLY and required the completion-verifier eval spec to pass; I had covered both kind values only in my NEW test files and never ran the eval spec. Real gap in delivery, not a gate defect - so I finished the work rather than forcing. Added: a dedicated both-spellings reconciler test (own fixture, so the shared one keeps its pinned 2-criterion shape - my first attempt mutated the shared fixture and broke 3 legitimate assertions), both kind spellings in the render fixture, and a canonical CV-non-codebase-* eval pair mirroring the legacy one, with CV-operator-attested-* RETAINED unchanged as alias coverage and stable ids. Eval-discipline gate 78 passed; S7 suites 38 passed; lint + mypy 598 clean. 1958 was already merged so it could not be amended - pushed as NEW change 1961 with a fresh Change-Id (I1c2ccfcc, distinct from the merged I0e32cf06). Note: 'git commit --amend -F' dropped the DCO sign-off (the exact hazard AGENTS.md flags for message replacement); re-added with --amend -s --no-edit.
